description: WareVolt Scale™ brings order, inventory, warehouse, shipping, and returns data into a single operational view — giving leadership the metrics to run the business proactively, not reactively.

Supply chains generate millions of discrete data points every single day. WareVolt Scale™ aggregates, normalizes, and visualizes this data into unified operational intelligence—giving your team instant clarity over order cycles, carrier SLA delivery, and warehouse throughput.

Identify delivery bottlenecks before they hurt customer reviews, measure true unit fulfillment economics, and streamline cross-facility operations with confidence backed by verifiable real-time analytics.
Full-spectrum fulfillment analytics engineered for high-growth commerce brands.

title: Real-Time Executive Dashboards
description: Monitor orders dispatched, fulfillment velocity, order aging, and delivery SLA compliance through intuitive visual dashboards.

title: Multi-Carrier SLA Benchmarking
description: Measure carrier transit times, on-time delivery rates, exception rates, and cost per kilogram across zones in real time.

title: Inventory Health & Aging Reports
description: Track SKU turnover ratios, slow-moving items, deadstock risks, and days-of-inventory on hand to optimize capital allocation.

title: Fulfillment Cost & Unit Economics

description: Uncover return patterns, customer return reasons, non-delivery reports (NDR), and transit damage metrics to minimize returns.

title: Labor & Warehouse Productivity
description: Analyze picks per hour, dock-to-stock turnaround times, packing speed, and shift-level throughput across fulfillment centers.

title: Demand Forecasting & Velocity

description: Export scheduled reports in CSV/Excel, configure automated email alerts, or stream live data via webhooks and BI connectors.
